items.title: Separate planning, implementation, and delivery truth
items.situation: Planning artifacts or generated files exist while canonical runtime, review, package, or delivery evidence may be incomplete.
items.action: Evaluate each evidence layer independently and allow only canonical producers and inspectors to authorize formal gates.
items.outcome: Progress remains visible without a false public delivery PASS.
applicable_when: CGKN planning, implementation, acceptance, and delivery work

items.title: Use bounded artifact projections instead of whole-history context
items.situation: A project has enough files or upstream evidence that copying complete context is noisy and expensive.
items.action: Keep complete local lineage and provide each bounded module only its declared artifacts, projections, policy, and contract.
items.outcome: Context remains traceable and unaffected checkpoints remain reusable.
not_applicable_when: A tiny single-file change where the projection exceeds the source

items.title: Promote curated evidence instead of tracking raw runs
items.situation: Reproducible runtime output accumulates in Git and obscures source, specs, and durable claims.
items.action: Keep runs local and promote only claim, status, metrics, hashes, reproduction commands, and limitations.
items.outcome: HEAD stays reviewable while important claims remain reproducible.
not_applicable_when: Canonical runtime storage during an active local run
